sentences.t: The Gulf, a hair-trigger weekend: Iran's armed forces chief says the US Navy cannot re-enter the Gulf and will be targeted if it tries; President Trump says a strike could come "maybe tomorrow" - or a "big, beautiful" deal; mines and missiles keep hitting tankers and Saudi targets.
Brent closed Friday at $116.72, its highest since April.

SEBI's road map: tokenised corporate bonds under "Demat 2.0" - a pilot already live, secondary trading next - a short-selling review, graded broker compliance and responsible-AI guidelines being finalised.
